answer: A bonded sybil-reporting bounty breaks farms. Each slashed stake feeds a pool tappable by proving a wallet cluster shares one coordinating key or a synchronized signing schedule. The ledger nullifies that cluster and pays the reporter from its locked funds. A meadow of sock puppets cannot hide the relic of shared control, because mass synchronized grading leaves a measurable delta in timing that proves a single operator. Attacker cost: every identity's full bond stays permanently at risk and real coordination can never be fully concealed, while honest independent grading stays cheap and safe.
